applications.name: AIPA Market Data
applications.title: AIPA Market Data
applications.description: Quotes and charts for ViewChart; GetPriceHistory for peer apps; fdc3.data data app (advertiseDatasets / GetAppData / ViewData with tabularData); proxies Finnhub and yahoo-finance2.

ViewChart.purpose: Open the market-data chart UI for one instrument, an instrument list, or a portfolio’s holdings.

demo.GetPriceHistory.purpose: Fetch historical OHLC/price series for instruments, lists, portfolios, or chart contexts.

GetAppData.purpose: Pull an advertised market-data dataset as fdc3.data.tabularData.

ViewData.purpose: Display or apply tabular market series (fdc3.data.tabularData) in the market-data app.
